items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 2 at 2:12PM EDT until October 2 at 3:15PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...

* Until 315 PM EDT.

* At 212 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Titusville
Airport, moving north at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Lagrange, Mims, Titusville Airport, Titusville, and Scottsmoor.
